title: Smart Plant Care System
subtitle: An IoT sensing project from the Possible Career Accelerator
pitch: Soil moisture, light, and temperature sensing on an STM32 with a sensor-to-mobile-app protocol and a care-recommendation dashboard.
highlights: Soil moisture, light, and temperature sensors on an STM32
Sensor-to-mobile-app protocol and a care-recommendation dashboard
Power management, accessibility features, and gamification
Selected for the accelerator as 1 of 25 students

blocks.md: Built during the Possible Career Accelerator (March to May 2025): soil moisture, light, and temperature sensors on an STM32, a sensor-to-mobile-app protocol, a care-recommendation dashboard, and power management, designed with formal product-design methods, accessibility features, and gamification.
